cohort: The participants were 145 postpartum mothers within one week of delivery.
finding: Postpartum depression was identified in 25.5% of new mothers and was strongly correlated with lower education status, economic reliance, nuclear or divorced households, psychiatric/medical comorbidities, prenatal problems, psychosocial conflict, and insufficient support.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was not found to be a significant predictor of postpartum depression.
